name: B06-PRIOR-MIXTURE
scope: Synthetic course mechanism; not original Mitra generators or paper scores
mixture_schedule: shuffled equally spaced uniforms; exactly320/640SCM tasks for mixed
label_rule: binary score > support score median, with score noise; median never fitted on queries
preprocessing: support mean and population standard deviation; floor1e-6
aggregation: query mean within task; equal task mean within family; paired seed contrasts; sample SD descriptive only
mixture_selection: 0.5 prespecified; no development or evaluation dataset used for selection
